name: body-uploader
description: Pulls full blocks from a Bitcoin Core node, extracts the txid list of each, and uploads it to the block_explorer canister.

scripts.codegen: didc bind -t ts block_explorer.did | sed 's#@dfinity/#@icp-sdk/core/#g' > block_explorer.did.d.ts && didc bind -t js block_explorer.did > block_explorer.did.js
